headline: 8 contracts catalogued on Ethereum; governance token, stablecoins, and proxy-governed architecture identified

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search for Ethereum surfaced 4 verified Avalon Labs contracts: USDa token (0x8a60e489...), AVL token (0x5c8d0c48...), sUSDa token (0x2b66aade...), and legacy AVALON token (0x7712739...).

Official docs site (docs.avalonfinance.xyz) describes deployments across Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Bitlayer, CoreDAO, and Merlin; no single canonical deployed-contracts page was located despite attempting to fetch docs.avalonfinance.xyz root.

Audit reports linked from https://www.avalonfinance.xyz/audits catalog 3 auditing firms (Salus, Slowmist, Blocksec) with report URLs in GitHub repos. Salus USDa audit dated 2024-10-18 located at GitHub.

GitHub org (github.com/avalonfinancexyz) confirmed active with 21 repositories including audit reports and governance-token code; no deployment artifact files (Foundry broadcast, hardhat-deploy, manual indexes) were accessible in this run.
Protocol operates on 6 chains per docs; only Ethereum was checked in detail per per-protocol-context. Per-protocol note states only Ethereum pinned—D5 multi-chain enumeration not required.
No factory contracts identified in core Avalon contracts. AVL and USDa are standard tokens (ERC20 / LayerZero OFT); no enumeration view calls attempted.
4 token contracts classified with 'token' role. AVL proxy uses EIP-1967 pattern with implementation at 0x3228995749610bea00b59c44f8d1df21c14027f1; proxy-admin role inferred but not yet queried.
All 4 discovered addresses traced to Etherscan verified contract pages. No snippet-only sightings retained.

rationale.verdict: Capability probe succeeded. Ethereum website and Etherscan name-tag search yielded 4 verified core contracts (USDa, AVL, sUSDa, legacy AVALON). Audits by Salus, Slowmist, Blocksec located and dated. GitHub org confirmed. Docs site mentions multi-chain but no single canonical deployment doc found. Next runs should inherit these 4 addresses and probe for additional control/admin/timelock contracts via on-chain reads.

evidence.shows: Website homepage confirms Avalon Labs as Bitcoin-backed CeDeFi lending platform with USDa stablecoin and DeFi lending products.
Audit reports page listing Salus, Slowmist, and Blocksec audits for DeFi Lending, USDa, AVL, USDaMinter, and USDaConvert contracts with GitHub repo links.
Verified USDa Token contract on Ethereum with 'Avalon Labs: USDa Token' name tag; LayerZero cross-chain token implementation.
Verified AVL Token contract on Ethereum with 'Avalon Labs: AVL Token' name tag; transparent proxy using EIP-1967 pattern with implementation at 0x3228995749610bea00b59c44f8d1df21c14027f1.
Verified sUSDa Token contract on Ethereum with 'Avalon Labs: sUSDa Token' name tag; staked USDa derivative token.
Token Tracker for AVALON token (0x7712739...) with standard ERC20 implementation; appears to be legacy or alternative Avalon Finance token.
GitHub organization with 21 repositories including audit reports (Salus, Slowmist, Blocksec) and governance-token code; no deployment manifests accessible in overview.
Salus audit report for USDa dated 2024-10-18 (PDF file metadata visible in GitHub blob page, full PDF content not extractable via fetch).
Documentation confirms Avalon deployed on Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Bitlayer, CoreDAO, and Merlin with DeFi lending product.

unknowns: D2: deployed_contracts_doc not located—docs.avalonfinance.xyz root fetch failed; no canonical addresses page found despite searching and fetching docs structure
D4: GitHub deployment artifacts—no Foundry broadcast, hardhat-deploy, or manual index files accessed; would require walking git tree at pinned SHA
D6: Factory enumeration—no pools/vaults enumerated; cap at 50 children not needed for current discovery

D7: Proxy admin identity—AVL proxy (0x5c8d0c48...) uses EIP-1967 pattern; admin role not yet read via on-chain API; implementation identified as 0x3228995749610bea00b59c44f8d1df21c14027f1 from Etherscan
D8: Control contracts—no governance multisig, timelock, or emergency guardian addresses surfaced in this run; likely exist but require on-chain reads

protocol_metadata.about: Avalon Labs operates a Bitcoin-backed CeDeFi lending platform offering stablecoins (USDa) and decentralized lending for Bitcoin and Bitcoin-backed assets. The protocol bridges centralized finance and DeFi through fixed-rate borrowing, custody partnerships with Cobo and Fireblock, and a governance token (AVL). Deployed across Ethereum and five additional blockchains.
